title: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions
summary: The OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions project publishes a shared schema for semantic attributes; the observed repository identifies specification version v1.61.0 and is licensed under Apache-2.0.
why_it_matters: A vendor-neutral semantic layer can keep observability evidence portable across telemetry backends.
practical_opportunity: Use the canonical conventions as an adapter input while retaining raw registry evidence independently.
termux_relevance: schema-only consumption is lightweight; exporter/runtime portability remains an implementation question

evidence.claim: Repository README identifies specification version v1.61.0.

unresolved_questions: Which GenAI semantic conventions stabilize for long-term interoperability?
Which attributes should be retained in the hub as raw evidence versus normalized projections?

procurement.maintenance: active project; verify cadence at ingestion time
procurement.dependency_risk: low for schema consumption; runtime dependencies vary by adapter
procurement.lock_in_risk: low at semantic-contract layer; exporter/provider lock-in remains adapter-specific
procurement.security_surface: low for static schema; exporter/runtime integrations vary
